assertions.name: best_variance_below_two_x
assertions.source: FR pullback grid scan finds best (K_1*, K_2*) pair at variance 1.5429×, well below the structural 2× ceiling. K_3* = 4_1 baseline is 1.5507× (matches PR #826).

assertions.name: baseline_matches_PR_826
assertions.source: K_3* = 4_1 baseline (FR at k=3 only) computed here: 1.5507×; PR #826 reported 1.551×. Cross-validates the FR-pullback formula implementation.

assertions.name: no_regression_vs_baseline
assertions.source: Best (K_1*, K_2*) variance 1.5429× vs K_3*-only baseline 1.5507×: improvement = +0.50% (positive = better; negative = regression — would fail this assertion).

description: Phase 5f: FR-pullback variance test at k=1 and k=2, extending PR #826's k=3 infrastructure. K_3* fixed at 4_1 (per #826). Sweeps (K_1*, K_2*) over a candidate set including hyperbolic knots {4_1, 5_2, 6_1} and torus-knot lepton-generation candidates {3_1, 5_1, 7_1} from PR #819 Phase 5d.5. Reports the (K_1*, K_2*) pair that minimises variance across D / T / ³He / ⁴He.
